source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "feminist urbanism" OR "gendered city" OR "women and the city" OR ("feminist geography" AND city)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"feminist urbanism" OR "gendered city" OR "women and the city" OR ("feminist geography" AND city),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("feminist urbanism" OR "gendered city" OR "women and the city" OR ("feminist geography" AND "city"))
